prompts.label: Ideal: firm & easy to pick up

visual.shape: firm cylindrical log segments, sausage-shaped, well-formed
visual.distinguishingFeature: holds shape firmly, can be picked up easily without leaving residue
visual.surface: smooth with slight natural sheen, may have light segmentation
visual.realLifeNote: Like a Tootsie Roll or firm sausage - compact, uniform brown, easy to pick up

prompts.prompt: Create a clean semi-realistic illustration, medical education style, simplified but accurate shapes of dog stool for a veterinary education app. Use realistic natural earth tones, true-to-life colors. Background: plain solid light neutral gray (#F0F0F0) background, no textures or patterns. Rendering: soft shading with realistic form, gentle shadow underneath for grounding. Camera angle: slightly elevated 3/4 view, as if looking down at the ground. SHAPE: firm cylindrical log segments, sausage-shaped, well-formed. COLOR: chocolate brown, consistent color throughout. KEY IDENTIFYING FEATURE: holds shape firmly, can be picked up easily without leaving residue. SURFACE/TEXTURE: smooth with slight natural sheen, may have light segmentation. REAL LIFE REFERENCE: Like a Tootsie Roll or firm sausage - compact, uniform brown, easy to pick up. Do NOT include: text or labels, cartoon faces or expressions, flies or insects, smell lines or stink marks, grass or outdoor environment, overly gross or disgusting details. This must look realistic enough that a pet owner can compare it to their dog's actual stool. The image should clearly show the distinguishing characteristics so owners know what to look for.

prompts.label: Soft but formed

visual.shape: soft log shape that is losing definition, edges are mushy and rounding out
visual.distinguishingFeature: still has some log form but visibly soft, would leave residue if picked up
visual.surface: moist, matte finish, edges appear to be settling into the ground
visual.realLifeNote: Like soft-serve ice cream consistency - still has shape but soft and mushy

prompts.label: Watery diarrhea

visual.shape: very loose mushy pile with no defined form, flat and spreading but still has some texture and small soft chunks
visual.color: medium brown, slightly lighter than normal due to moisture
visual.distinguishingFeature: lost log shape completely, flat mushy mess, but still has some chunky texture - not pure liquid
visual.surface: wet and glossy, uneven lumpy texture, spreading at edges
visual.realLifeNote: Like very loose oatmeal or thick muddy slurry - has substance but no form, messy pile
